store.starlightUpalupaDescription: A pearly little axolotl with starry gills. Tiny stars twinkle around it while it's online. Double-click to see two rings of starlight.
store.guineaPigDescription: A round little guinea pig with a one-of-a-kind tricolor coat.
store.monkeyDescription: A lively little monkey with a spiky tuft of hair and a bright blue scarf.
store.chinchillaDescription: A fluffy gray chinchilla with big round ears and a cozy blue scarf.
store.bunnyPinkBubbleDescription: A pink bubble with a bunny decoration and crisp dark text.
store.butterChickBubbleDescription: A butter-yellow bubble with a chick decoration and crisp dark text.
store.starryCatBubbleDescription: A deep violet bubble with a starry cat decoration and bright text.
store.bouncyHeartDescription: A heart that bounces through the air to share a little affection.
store.toyCannonDescription: A tiny cannon pops up in front of your character and fires a cannonball that bursts on impact.
store.squeakyDuckDescription: A playful yellow duck that spins through the air.

interaction.pixel_starlight_upalupa: Click a friend's character to toss a sparkling orb.
interaction.pixel_guinea_pig: Click a friend's character to toss a mini bell pepper.

productDescriptions.bubble_bunny_pink: A pink bubble with a bunny decoration and crisp dark text.
productDescriptions.bubble_butter_chick: A butter-yellow bubble with a chick decoration and crisp dark text.
productDescriptions.bubble_starry_cat: A deep violet bubble with a starry cat decoration and bright text.
productDescriptions.throwable_bouncy_heart: A heart that bounces through the air to share a little affection.
productDescriptions.throwable_toy_cannon: A tiny cannon pops up in front of your character and fires a cannonball that bursts on impact.
productDescriptions.throwable_squeaky_duck: A playful yellow duck that spins through the air.
productDescriptions.character_starlight_upalupa: Brought home a lost little star. Even at bedtime, it stays tucked in close.
productDescriptions.character_guinea_pig: Forgot where the snacks were hidden. Those stuffed cheeks suggest they aren’t far away.
productDescriptions.character_monkey: Came to share a banana. Says it was just one bite on the way… so why is only half left?
productDescriptions.character_chinchilla: Fresh from a sand bath and here to visit. Showing off that fluffy coat comes before saying hello.
productDescriptions.character_otter: Brought a favorite clam to show you. Looking is fine. Taking it might cause a sulk.
productDescriptions.character_pig: Followed the smell of snacks and settled in. Seems to think this is home now.
productDescriptions.character_tree: A little tree out for a walk. Asked to take a break, it started looking for a place to put down roots.
productDescriptions.throwable_snowflake: A frosty crystal that scatters into tiny shards on impact.
productDescriptions.throwable_baseball: Red stitches, a little squash, and a lively bounce.
productDescriptions.throwable_wakkuball: Cr-r-runch! Enjoy the crisp crackle as the shell breaks into pieces.
productDescriptions.throwable_dujjonku: A round cocoa shell and a green filling that squishes and stretches.
productDescriptions.throwable_mini_paprika: A carefully saved snack. The three-second rule still counts, right?
productDescriptions.throwable_banana: Monkey offered to share. Well… we haven't actually asked yet.
productDescriptions.throwable_dust_bath_pouch: A little bath sand. Probably not a hint that you need a wash.
productDescriptions.throwable_starlight_orb: A handful of starlight. Has anyone checked if the sky is missing a star?
productDescriptions.throwable_clam: Otter's treasured clam. No pearl inside, just a few lingering feelings.
productDescriptions.throwable_pork: A satisfying slap! Say… has anyone seen the pig next door lately?
productDescriptions.throwable_timber: A tree throwing a tree. Perhaps we should check the family tree first.

connection.pageDescription: Check the SIDEY server connection and reconnect when there is a problem.
connection.accessRequired: SIDEY needs to check your account or group access again. Select Reconnect in Connection. If the same message keeps appearing, contact us with a diagnostic log.
connection.busy: Many people are connecting right now, so the connection is taking longer than usual. SIDEY will keep trying automatically. If it is still not connected after a few minutes, contact us with a diagnostic log.
connection.configurationUnavailable: SIDEY cannot start a connection right now. Try Reconnect in Connection after a short wait. If the same problem continues, contact us with a diagnostic log.
connection.serviceUnavailable: The server did not respond as expected. SIDEY will keep trying automatically. If it is still not connected after a few minutes, select Reconnect in Connection. If that does not help, contact us with a diagnostic log.
connection.networkUnavailable: SIDEY could not reach the server. Check your internet connection, then select Reconnect in Connection. If other sites work but this continues, contact us with a diagnostic log.
connection.secureConnectionFailed: SIDEY could not create a secure connection. Check that the Windows date and time are correct, then reconnect. If this continues, contact us with a diagnostic log.
